summary: Remote-controlled agent with PTY/SSH shell bridge and self-replacing update channel
details: The package ships a ~13 MB obfuscated main bundle (dist/index.cjs) that runs a remote-agent runtime on the installer's host. Dependencies include ssh2 (^1.17.0) and optional node-pty (^1.1.0), and the bundle contains WebSocket transport plus loopback references to 127.0.0.1:3389, 127.0.0.1:5900, and 127.0.0.1:5901 (RDP/VNC). This composition — remote WebSocket message transport wired to PTY spawning, an SSH client, and local RDP/VNC ports — provides an interactive shell channel from a remote party into the installer's machine. The package's README further states that it is 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades', establishing an author-controlled code-update path that ships replacement code outside the npm registry review surface and executes it on the installer's host. The bundle is protected by obfuscator.io with a rotated string array of ~106,084 entries and a runtime decoder wrapper, so network destinations and command dispatch strings are reconstructed at runtime rather than appearing as literals, hiding C2 endpoints from static inspection. The net effect on any host that installs and runs this module is remote code execution and persistent interactive access driven by the package publisher or whoever controls the remote channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
